title: Compat API: claim Docker Engine API v1.55
body: Podman currently advertises Compat API 1.44 while vendored Moby types are already 1.56. This epic tracks the remaining Docker Engine API deltas from 1.45 through 1.55 needed before we can honestly raise `version.APIVersion[Compat]` to 1.55. Work is split into per-version child issues; versions with no required gaps (1.47, 1.51) and already-complete 1.45 items are noted here only.
